subject: FLASH-2 & FLASH-3 DIRECTIVES: 32 NFL Team Source Packs & 32 Stadium Geo/Turf/Altitude Matrix
body:
FLASH DIRECTIVES (Active & Queued):

1. ACTIVE (FLASH-2) — 32 NFL Team Source Packs:
- Aggregate verified team beat reporters, depth charts, and injury tracking feeds across all 32 NFL teams.
- Store structured schema under data/nfl/team-packs/ with primary beat reporters, reliable injury timeline sources, and snap count rotations.

2. QUEUED BACKLOG (FLASH-3) — 32 Stadium Geo/Turf/Altitude Matrix:
- Map all 32 NFL venues with exact physical parameters:
  * Stadium name, lat/lon coordinates, orientation (azimuth degrees for crosswind vs headwind).
  * Altitude (Denver 5,280 ft vs sea level).
  * Surface type: Natural Grass (Kentucky Bluegrass, Bermuda) vs Artificial Turf (FieldTurf, Matrix Turf, slit-film).
  * Roof type: Open, Retractable, Fixed Dome.
